title.narrative: Comoros Second Fiscal Management and Resilient Growth Development Policy Financing

description.narrative: The Program Development Objectives are to support the Government of Comoros in their efforts to: (i) enhance debt management and public expenditure efficiency; (ii) strengthen resilience to shocks; and (iii) improve state-owned enterprises governance and performance.

The development objectives of the Second Fiscal Management and Resilient Growth Development Policy Financing for Comoros are to support the Government of Comoros in their efforts to: (i) enhance debt management and public expenditure efficiency; (ii) strengthen resilience to shocks; and (iii) improve state-owned enterprises governance and performance. The Government's priorities are articulated in the Plan Comores Emergent (PCE), the national development strategy for 2019-2030, and a medium-term recovery plan (2022-26) approved in December 2022. The PCE is structured around five strategic pillars: (i) tourism and crafts development, (ii) promotion of the blue economy, (iii) positioning Comoros as a regional financial hub, (iv) modernization of agriculture for food security, and (v) industrial diversification. These are supported by five essential catalysts: (i) political stability and reforms, (ii) infrastructure, (iii) human capital, (iv) a competitive environment, and (v) digital transformation.
